parts.name: Steel Floor Mount Bracket
parts.description: Carbon steel floor mount bracket with an attached profile socket on a base plate; the profile is held by the included M8 x 25mm SHCS set screw and four holes in the base plate mount it to the floor.

Four holes for flooring mounting
Install two extrusions with 2412 or 45-2412

page_notes.549: Steel Floor Mount Brackets (6-37): 2411 and 2412 badged 15 + 40 metric extracted; 45-2411/45-2412 metric-only skipped; Suggested Profile Series table folded into notes.
page_notes.550: Floor Mount Base Plate (6-38): 15-series 2390/2400/2410 Clear and Black extracted; 10-series 2380/2385/2387 skipped.
page_notes.551: Floor Mount Base Plate continued (6-39): metric-only rows skipped; Material Specifications and Suggested Hardware (3325, 3320 15-series rows) applied to the 15-series parts from 6-38.
page_notes.552: Economy Floor Mount Base Plate (6-40): 15-series 2415/2417/2405 Clear and Black extracted; 10-series 2414/2416/2404 skipped.
page_notes.553: Economy Floor Mount Base Plate continued (6-41): metric-only rows skipped; Material Specifications and Suggested Hardware (3325, 3320) applied to the 15-series parts from 6-40.
page_notes.554: Slotted Economy Floor Mount Base Plate (6-42): 2413 and 2413-Black (15 + RT) extracted with material specs; 3320 suggested hardware attached, 3960 RT-only hardware noted.

corrected: 2390, 2390-Black, 2400, 2400-Black, 2410, 2410-Black: dimension_notes 'P = upright plate height, N = upright plate thickness, R. G = corner radius' -> 'P = overall base plate depth, N = base plate thickness, R. G = anchor slot end radius' (side view shows P/N on the base plate seen edge-on, R. G leader points to slot end; B = (P - A)/2 confirms); also added A, F, H, R definitions

2390, 2390-Black, 2400, 2400-Black, 2410, 2410-Black: description 'two upright plates bolt to the sides of a profile' -> 'two upright plates that support the sides of a profile' (wording of the printed feature)

2411, 2412: dimension_notes 'B and C = socket outside dimensions' -> 'B and C = socket opening (inside) dimensions' (45-2412 B = 3.593” vs a 90mm profile leaves no room for a wall, so B/C are inside dimensions)
remaining_doubts: 2411/2412 are badged 15 and 40 (metric); series kept as ["15"] with the metric badge mentioned in notes.
Suggested hardware qty kept as the printed range strings ('4 to 8', '2 to 6') rather than integers.

Material Specifications and Suggested Hardware for the Floor Mount Base Plate and Economy Floor Mount Base Plate are printed on the continued pages (6-39, 6-41) and were applied to the inch 15-series parts from 6-38 and 6-40.
2413/2413-Black: RT-only suggested hardware 3960 kept in notes, not in suggested_hardware.
